description: Computes the weighted expense ratio of a list of holdings from dated issuer fee records, and the fee cost over 10 and 30 years on a flat $100,000 balance (before growth), using the same formula as the Portfolio Optimizer Pro expense ratio calculator. Single companies count as 0% fund fee. If any fund fee is not verified the weighted fee is null and the ticker is listed, rather than estimated.

holdings.description: The portfolio: 1 to 30 holdings, each ticker once, with its weight.

ticker.description: Fund or company ticker symbol as listed on a US exchange, e.g. "VTI".

weight.description: Share of the portfolio. Percent (60 = 60%) or fraction (0.6); weights are normalized to total 100%.

name: fund_fee_cost

expense_ratio_pct.description: Annual expense ratio in percent; 0 for a single company; null when not verified.

weighted_expense_ratio_pct.description: Null when any fund fee is not verified.

title: Fund fee cost
